_meta.note: 一個故事一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Boulder Pit#001.src: Woah! What did you push this for?
Boulder Pit#001.dst: うわっ！　これ、なんで押したの？
Boulder Pit#001.speaker: Junes

Boulder Pit#002.src: There were markings all over it.. And a small entrance to the inside.
Boulder Pit#002.dst: その表面には至る所に刻印があり……そして、内部へと続く小さな入り口があった。
Boulder Pit#002.speaker: Junes

Boulder Pit#003.src: I wonder why... Wait - Where are we?
Boulder Pit#003.dst: どうしてだろう……あれ、ここはどこだ？
Boulder Pit#003.speaker: Junes

Boulder Pit#004.src: How do you keep finding these ruins?
Boulder Pit#004.dst: どうしていつもこんな遺跡を見つけられるの？
Boulder Pit#004.speaker: Junes

Boulder Pit#005.src: My word.. This body.. It's definitely not from the fallen empire.
Boulder Pit#005.dst: なんてこった……この体……間違いなく、堕ちた帝国のものではない。
Boulder Pit#005.speaker: Junes

Boulder Pit#006.src: It's relatively new.. Maybe from the last {~} years.
Boulder Pit#006.dst: 比較的新しい…たぶんここ{~}年くらいのものだと思う。
Boulder Pit#006.speaker: Junes

Boulder Pit#007.src: I've seen evidence all over these buildings of people living in them or storing goods.
Boulder Pit#007.dst: これらの建物の至る所に、人が住んでいた形跡や、物が保管されていた形跡が見受けられる。
Boulder Pit#007.speaker: Junes

Boulder Pit#008.src: I guess it's only natural when an empire as big as this one still stands.
Boulder Pit#008.dst: これほど巨大な帝国が今もなお存続しているのだから、それは当然のことだろう。
Boulder Pit#008.speaker: Junes

Boulder Pit#009.src: There must be hundreds of convenient hiding places, this poor guy must have got trapped.
Boulder Pit#009.dst: 便利な隠れ場所は数百カ所もあるはずだ。このかわいそうな奴は、きっとそこに閉じ込められてしまったに違いない。
Boulder Pit#009.speaker: Junes

Boulder Pit#010.src: Seems like he couldn't get the door open. Maybe the wood has rotted by now...
Boulder Pit#010.dst: どうやら彼はドアを開けることができなかったようだ。もう木が腐ってしまっているのかもしれない……
Boulder Pit#010.speaker: Junes

Totem Pole#001.src: A vision of the past presents itself to you...
Totem Pole#001.dst: {c1}過去の光景が眼前に浮かび上がる……{/}
Totem Pole#001.note: {c1}A vision of the past presents itself to you...{/}

Totem Pole#002.src: Even though you can clearly hear the tribesmen talking they appear to be speaking in a language you've never heard before.
Totem Pole#002.dst: {c1}部族の人たちの会話ははっきりと聞こえるものの、彼らが話しているのは、これまで聞いたことのない言語のように思える。{/}
Totem Pole#002.note: {c1}Even though you can clearly hear the tribesmen talking they appear to be speaking in a language you've never heard before.{/}

Totem Pole#003.src: The sandstorm has been raging on for months, we HAVE to leave.
Totem Pole#003.dst: 砂嵐が数ヶ月も吹き荒れている。もうここを離れなければならない。
Totem Pole#003.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#004.src: We won't make it out there...
Totem Pole#004.dst: あそこまではたどり着けないだろう……
Totem Pole#004.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#005.src: We won't make it in here. We're almost out of food.
Totem Pole#005.dst: ここにはもういられない。食料もほとんど底をついてしまった。
Totem Pole#005.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#006.src: Sandstorms usually only last days, maybe weeks. We must have upset the gods.
Totem Pole#006.dst: 砂嵐は通常、数日、せいぜい数週間しか続かないものだ。どうやら我々は神々の機嫌を損ねてしまったようだ。
Totem Pole#006.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#007.src: I don't think so. I feel the lingering stench of betrayal in the air.
Totem Pole#007.dst: そうは思わないな。空気中には、裏切りの悪臭がまだ漂っている気がする。
Totem Pole#007.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#008.src: This is a magical storm. We need to find a magical solution.
Totem Pole#008.dst: これは魔法の嵐だ。魔法のような解決策を見つけなければならない。
Totem Pole#008.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#009.src: Either way, we need to leave, or we're dead.
Totem Pole#009.dst: いずれにせよ、ここから出ないと、私たちは死んでしまう。
Totem Pole#009.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#010.src: I wonder what is happening out there in the citadel?
Totem Pole#010.dst: あの城塞では、一体何が起きているのだろうか？
Totem Pole#010.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#011.src: It's a child's book. It's covered in pictures of sandstorms featuring some kind of stick.
Totem Pole#011.dst: {c1}これは子供向けの本だ。表紙には、ある種の棒が登場する砂嵐の絵がびっしりと描かれている。{/}
Totem Pole#011.note: {c1}It's a child's book. It's covered in pictures of sandstorms featuring some kind of stick.{/}
